 Talking points
 Limping to the break
 The New Zealand Breakers were one of the most promising teams through the first five rounds of the season, and Parker Jackson-Cartwright was a major reason why. With the devastating news that he will miss the rest of NBL27, the Breakers’ five-game losing streak looks even more disheartening. They need to get some healthy bodies back on the floor and, in the meantime, stop the rot with a big win.
 Bullets to fire back
 The Brisbane Bullets look to have completely turned their club around in one off-season, already matching last season’s win total in the first eight rounds of NBL27. Unfortunately for Will Weaver’s team, they too have been hit by injuries, but after a disappointing result in Melbourne, this is a big opportunity to bounce back. Despite a lengthy injury list, they’re still led by Nate Hinton and Raul Neto, who have been a delight to watch.
